## The owner's words (15 Nov, after playing)

- "lava should be a pit - recessed deep into the ground, and slightly less thick so its easier to jump without
  being fully accurate"
- "level design - I cant tell if this is the procedural variant yet, but if it is, this isnt exactly correct. it
  still feels very linear and uninteresting, mainly because its a straight line to the finish always regardless,
  there are no actual rooms, bends and so on, and all the levels are short. I feel like after the first 2 stages
  they need to be more winding and have doorways and such to give it some atmosphere and challenge, so the
  limited clapperboards also feel more like a challenge. right now every stage is so short that clapperboards
  dont really matter, every level can be outnavigated with the use of 1 or 0 clapperboards, so the fix would be
  to make later stages longer."

The clapperboard is the game's main tool: a limited number of charges per stage, each freezes the scene for a
few seconds.

Lane farm1, 14 Nov 2026. Other PCs build, test, package and run SUPERCUT for lanes on c4. Git, agents and the
source of truth stay on c4. A farm PC holds a plain copy of a project folder (a "mirror"), never a git repo.
Nothing is ever pushed with git.

| PC | Root | Ready | Build | Tests | Package | Scripted run | Lanes at once |

| `[pc-b]` | `C:\UE` | **yes** (17:33) | yes | yes | Development and Shipping | yes, offscreen | 2 (builds queue, see below) |

	SupercutProps::Catalogue();   // a bad catalogue stops the game here, before any room is read
	SupercutCredits::Get();       // so does a missing or empty credits file

	FString RunName = TEXT("main");
	FString RoomName;
	int32 Seed = int32(FPlatformTime::Cycles64() & 0x7fffffff);
	FString UpgradeText;
	// Read in every build, so a Shipping build can be checked with a script.
	FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("-SupercutRun="), RunName);
	FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("-SupercutRoom="), RoomName);
	FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("-SupercutSeed="), Seed);
	FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("-SupercutUpgrades="), UpgradeText, false);   // false: read past the commas (Parse.cpp)
	TArray<FString> UpgradeNames;
	UpgradeText.ParseIntoArray(UpgradeNames, TEXT(","));
	TArray<FName> Upgrades;
	for (const FString& Name : UpgradeNames)
	{
		Upgrades.Add(FName(*Name));
	}
	// A start that names no run and no room plays a generated run, picked by the seed (SupercutGeneratedRuns.h).
	if (SupercutGeneratedRuns::PlaysGeneratedRun(FCommandLine::Get(), FSupercutTuning::Get().GeneratedRuns))
	{
		RunName = SupercutGeneratedRuns::RunName(Seed, FSupercutTuning::Get().GeneratedRuns);
	}

	// The first room has to stand before the player logs in, which is earlier than StartPlay.
	const TArray<FString> Rooms = RoomName.IsEmpty() ? SupercutRoomFile::LoadRunOrDie(RunName) : TArray<FString>{ RoomName };
	USupercutRun::Get(this).SetStartUpgrades(Upgrades);
	USupercutRun::Get(this).Begin(Rooms, Seed, USupercutRun::StartsAtTitle(FCommandLine::Get()));
}

AActor* ASupercutGameMode::ChoosePlayerStart_Implementation(AController* Player)
{
	// The engine wants an actor to stand for the start. The player's real place comes from the room file's start line.
	return USupercutRun::Get(this).GetRoom();
}

void ASupercutGameMode::RestartPlayer(AController* NewPlayer)
{
	USupercutRun& Run = USupercutRun::Get(this);
	ASupercutCharacter* Hero = Run.GetHero();
	checkf(Hero, TEXT("ASupercutGameMode::RestartPlayer: the run has no character for the player"));
	NewPlayer->Possess(Hero);
	NewPlayer->SetControlRotation(Hero->GetActorRotation());
}

void USupercutRun::Begin(const TArray<FString>& InRoomNames, int32 Seed, bool bTitle)
{
	checkf(Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Idle, TEXT("USupercutRun::Begin: a run is on already"));
	checkf(InRoomNames.Num() > 0, TEXT("USupercutRun::Begin: the run has no rooms"));
	for (const FString& Name : InRoomNames)
	{
		SupercutRoomFile::LoadOrDie(Name);
	}
	RoomNames = InRoomNames;
	RunSeed = Seed;
	Random.Initialize(Seed);
	Take = 1;
	Stats = FSupercutRunStats();
	if (bTitle)
	{
		Held.Reset();
		SupercutUpgrades::ApplyRules(*this);
		EnterRoom(0, true, true);
		return;
	}
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("RUN begins: %d rooms (%s), seed %d"), RoomNames.Num(), *FString::Join(RoomNames, TEXT(", ")), Seed);
	StartTake();
}

void USupercutRun::StartFromTitle()
{
	checkf(Phase == ESupercutRunPhase::Title, TEXT("USupercutRun::StartFromTitle: the title screen is not up"));
	SetPaused(false);
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("RUN begins: %d rooms (%s), seed %d"), RoomNames.Num(), *FString::Join(RoomNames, TEXT(", ")), RunSeed);
	StartTake();
}

void USupercutRun::RestartRun()
{
	checkf(Phase != ESupercutRunPhase::Idle && Phase != ESupercutRunPhase::Title, TEXT("USupercutRun::RestartRun: no run is on"));
	StartOver(TEXT("RUN restarts"), true);
}

void USupercutRun::StartOver(const TCHAR* Why, bool bFreshOffers)
{
	SetPaused(false);
	Offer.Reset();
	if (bFreshOffers)
	{
		Random.Initialize(RunSeed);
	}
	Take = 1;
	Stats = FSupercutRunStats();
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("%s"), Why);
	StartTake();
}

void USupercutRun::ShowTitle()
{
	checkf(Phase != ESupercutRunPhase::Idle && Phase != ESupercutRunPhase::Title, TEXT("USupercutRun::ShowTitle: no run is on"));
	Offer.Reset();
	Random.Initialize(RunSeed);
	Take = 1;
	Stats = FSupercutRunStats();
	Held.Reset();
	SupercutUpgrades::ApplyRules(*this);
	USupercutAudio::Get(this).MusicStop();
	EnterRoom(0, true, true);
}

# The room generator

Lane gen2, 14 Nov 2026. Copied from lane gen1 (`unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/gen1/gen`, and its
`test_vectors.json`). Python 3, standard library only. Run everything from this folder. Set
`PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` so Python leaves no `__pycache__` in the tree.

A room comes from `(seed, depth)`. The checker (`check.py`) refuses any room that is not fair, and the generator
then builds the next attempt of the same room. Nothing is written that the checker did not pass.

## Bake runs for the game

One run of 12 rooms for one seed, without props (what the game loads today):

```
python gen.py run 7 --out ../../Content --depths 12 --noprops
```

It writes `Content/Rooms/gen/s7/d01.txt` to `d12.txt` and `Content/Runs/gen_s7.txt`. The game picks run
`gen_s<1 + seed % GeneratedRuns>`, so the baked seeds must be 1 to `GeneratedRuns` with no gap. To ship more runs,
bake seeds `GeneratedRuns + 1` onward and raise the default of `GeneratedRuns` in `Source/Supercut/SupercutTuning.h`
(a Shipping build never reads Tuning.txt; the row in `SupercutTuningFile.cpp` allows up to 100000).

```
for s in $(seq 1 50); do python gen.py run $s --out ../../Content --depths 12; done

# plan_slot(seed, depth, known) walks depths 1..depth with one random stream that depends on the seed only,
# so any room of a run can be asked for alone and the answer never depends on which rooms were built before.

    """The last row of a 'from_depth' table that starts at or before depth."""
    row = table[0]
    for r in table:

    out = []
    for i in range(len(P["tags"])):
        if (known >> i) & 1:
            out.append(P["tags"][i])

    """Returns the slot for this depth:

    learned = known_tags(P, known)

def make_room(data, seed, depth, known, checked=True, props=1):
    """Returns (room, attempts used, list of [attempt, reasons] for every refused attempt)."""
    refused = []
    if not checked:
        return build_room(data, seed, depth, 0, known, props), 1, refused
    from check import check_room
    for attempt in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
        room = build_room(data, seed, depth, attempt, known, props)

	/** Reads from= and to= as the two opposite corners of a box. from must be the lower corner on every axis. */
	FBox Corners(FSupercutPieceReader& In)
	{
		const FVector From = In.Vector(TEXT("from"));
		const FVector To = In.Vector(TEXT("to"));
		if (From.X >= To.X || From.Y >= To.Y || From.Z >= To.Z)
		{
			In.Fail(FString::Printf(TEXT("from=%.0f,%.0f,%.0f must be lower than to=%.0f,%.0f,%.0f on x, y and z"), From.X, From.Y, From.Z, To.X, To.Y, To.Z));
		}
		return FBox(From, To);
	}

You are the director on a set that fights back: snap the clapperboard, the scene stops, you walk
through it and set up the shot, then it all plays out.

## The clapperboard

Numbers are starting values. They live in one tunables struct so a change is one line.

| Rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Charges | 3 |
| Freeze length | 4.0 s |
| End a freeze early | press the clapperboard again |
| Refill | full on entering a room; a film can pickup gives +1 `[pick]` |

While time is frozen:

- Enemies, enemy shots, moving machines and hazards stop where they are. The player moves and
  looks at full speed.
- Nothing frozen can hurt the player. A frozen enemy shot is harmless to touch.
- The player can fire. Each shot leaves the gun, travels about 1 m and hangs in the air. When time
  resumes, every hanging shot flies at once. `[pick]` This is what makes the freeze a setup tool

Three puzzle ideas, each used at least twice, each solved with the clapperboard:

1. **Stop the machine.** A turbine, fan or crusher blocks the way; freeze it and go through.
2. **Frozen-only glyphs.** Marks that show only in frozen time give the code for a door.
3. **Stand on what you froze.** A falling crate, a moving platform or an enemy shot becomes a
   step while it is frozen. `[pick]`

A puzzle room can never be left unwinnable: charges refill on entry and at a refill pad, which also puts
the room's puzzle pieces back to their start.

The pieces (lane `puzzles`, 13 Nov): a door; plates that open it when shot in the order the frozen-only
glyphs give; a switch that opens a door for a few seconds of scene time, which a freeze stops; a dropper
whose falling crates are solid only while frozen; the refill pad.

```
void USupercutRun::StartTake()
{
	Held.Reset();
	SupercutUpgrades::ApplyRules(*this);
	for (const FName Key : StartUpgrades)
	{
		Grant(Key);
	}
	const USupercutTime& Time = USupercutTime::Get(this);
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("TAKE %d begins: %d upgrades held, freezes last %.1f s, the board holds %d charges"), Take, Held.Num(), Time.GetFreezeLength(), Time.GetMaxCharges());
	EnterRoom(0, true);
}

int32 USupercutRun::LeaveRoom()
{
	UWorld* World = GetWorld();
	USupercutTime::Get(this).EndScene();
	USupercutEffects::Get(this).EndAll();

	int32 Removed = 0;
	for (TActorIterator<ASupercutShot> Shot(World); Shot; ++Shot)
	{
		Shot->Destroy();
		++Removed;
	}
	for (TActorIterator<ASupercutChips> Falling(World); Falling; ++Falling)
	{
		Falling->Destroy();   // chips and shells still in the air; the landed ones go with the room
		++Removed;
	}
	if (Room)
	{
		Removed += Room->TearDown();
		Room = nullptr;
	}
	// The engine frees the destroyed actors at the end of this frame, not at some later moment in the next room.
	GEngine->ForceGarbageCollection(true);
	return Removed;
}

def carve_pits(pieces, spec):
    """Every 'pit' piece becomes a pit sunk into the floor it lies on (lane gen3, 15 Nov 2026): the floor boxes round
       it are cut so the opening is bare, a burnt lip 'lip' wide runs round it at floor level and goes down as the
       pit's walls to a bed 'depth' below the floor. The bed carries the hazard's glowing surface; the kill box fills
       the pit from the bed to just above the floor, so touching the opening kills as the flat strip did.
       Pieces keep their order: a cut floor's boxes stand where the floor stood, the pits' own pieces come last."""
    pits = [p for p in pieces if p["t"] == "pit"]

Walls, floors, burnt lips, fire pits, cover, doorways,\n# enemies, start, gate, and the walked path from the stage's \"# path:\" line with its length.\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\nGEN = sys.argv[1]\nOUT = sys.argv[2]\nsys.path.insert(0, GEN)\nos.environ[\"PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE\"] = \"1\"\nfrom sc_build import load_data          # noqa: E402\nfrom sc_room import parse_room          # noqa: E402\nfrom gen import make_room               # noqa: E402\n\nCOL = {\"floor\": (214, 210, 200), \"ledge\": (190, 196, 206), \"wall\": (60, 60, 64), \"flat\": (150, 110, 70),\n       \"crate\": (175, 140, 95), \"scorch\": (45, 32, 26), \"metal\": (90, 90, 100)}\nFONT = ImageFont.load_default()\n\n\ndef draw_stage(text, meta, W=960):\n    room = parse_room(text)\n    ps = room[\"pieces\"]\n    boxes = [p for p in ps if p[\"t\"] in [\"box\", \"kill\"]]\n    xs = [b[\"from\"][0] for b in boxes] + [b[\"to\"][0] for b in boxes]\n    ys = [b[\"from\"][1] for b in boxes] + [b[\"to\"][1] for b in boxes]\n    x0, x1, y0, y1 = min(xs) - 100, max(xs) + 100, min(ys) - 100, max(ys) + 100\n    s = (W - 20) / (x1 - x0)\n    H = int((y1 - y0) * s) + 60\n    if H > 1400:\n        s = 1340 / (y1 - y0)\n        H = 1400\n    img = Image.new(\"RGB\", (W, H), (28, 28, 30))\n    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)\n\n    def P(x, y):\n        return (10 + (x - x0) * s, 50 + (y - y0) * s)     # stage +y is down the page\n\n    def rect(f, t, c, outline=None):\n        a = P(f[0], f[1]); b = P(t[0], t[1])\n        d.rectangle([a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1]], fill=c, outline=outline)\n\n    order = [\"floor\", \"ledge\", \"scorch\", \"crate\", \"flat\", \"metal\", \"wall\"]\n    for role in order:\n        for p in ps:\n            if p[\"t\"] == \"box\" and p[\"role\"] == role:\n                if role == \"floor\" and p[\"to\"][2] - p[\"from\"][2] == 50 and False:\n                    pass\n                rect(p[\"from\"], p[\"to\"], COL[role])\n    for p in ps:\n        if p[\"t\"] == \"kill\":\n            rect(p[\"from\"], p[\"to\"], (235, 90, 30))\n        if p[\"t\"] == \"door\":\n            a = p[\"at\"]\n            rect([a[0] - 40, a[1] - 40], [a[0] + 40, a[1] + 40], (120, 120, 200))\n        if p[\"t\"] == \"refill\":\n            a = p[\"at\"]; c = P(a[0], a[1]); r = 90 * s\n            d.ellipse([c[0] - r, c[1] - r, c[0] + r, c[1] + r], outline=(80, 160, 255), width=2)\n        if p[\"t\"] == \"blade\" or p[\"t\"] == \"platform\" or p[\"t\"] == \"dropper\":\n            a = p[\"at\"] if \"at\" in p else p[\"from\"]\n            c = P(a[0], a[1])\n            d.text((c[0] - 3, c[1] - 6), p[\"t\"][0].upper(), fill=(255, 255, 255), font=FONT)\n    # doorways from the header\n    for line in text.split(\"\\n\"):\n        if line.startswith(\"# doorway\"):\n            kv = dict(w.split(\"=\") for w in line.split(\":\", 1)[1].split())\n            ax, ay, az = [int(v) for v in kv[\"at\"].split(\",\")]\n            c = P(ax, ay)\n            d.ellipse([c[0] - 6, c[1] - 6, c[0] + 6, c[1] + 6], fill=(90, 200, 120))\n    path = None\n    for line in text.split(\"\\n\"):\n        if line.startswith(\"# path:\"):\n            path = [[int(v) for v in w.split(\",\")] for w in line[7:].split()]\n    if path:\n        d.line([P(p[0], p[1]) for p in path], fill=(255, 220, 60), width=2)\n    for p in ps:\n        if p[\"t\"] in [\"grunt\", \"rusher\", \"marksman\"]:\n            a = p[\"at\"]; c = P(a[0], a[1]); r = max(4, 40 * s)\n            col = {\"grunt\": (220, 60, 60), \"rusher\": (240, 140, 40), \"marksman\": (200, 60, 200)}[p[\"t\"]]\n            d.ellipse([c[0] - r, c[1] - r, c[0] + r, c[1] + r], fill=col)\n            d.text((c[0] + r + 1, c[1] - 6), p[\"t\"][0].upper(), fill=col, font=FONT)\n        if p[\"t\"] == \"start\":\n            a = p[\"at\"]; c = P(a[0], a[1])\n            d.rectangle([c[0] - 6, c[1] - 6, c[0] + 6, c[1] + 6], fill=(255, 255, 255))\n            d.text((c[0] + 8, c[1] - 6), \"START\", fill=(255, 255, 255), font=FONT)\n        if p[\"t\"] == \"gate\":\n            a = p[\"at\"]; c = P(a[0], a[1])\n            d.rectangle([c[0] - 6, c[1] - 6, c[0] + 6, c[1] + 6], fill=(60, 230, 90))\n            d.text((c[0] + 8, c[1] - 6), \"FINISH\", fill=(60, 230, 90), font=FONT)\n    head = room[\"head\"]\n    title = \"seed %s stage %s  %s %s  \" % (head.get(\"seed\"), head.get(\"depth\"), head.get(\"kind\"), head.get(\"form\"))\n    if meta.get(\"wound\"):\n        title += \"chambers %d  turns %d  walked path %.1f m  hard fights %d\" % (meta[\"chambers\"], meta[\"turns\"], meta[\"path\"] / 100.0, meta[\"hard\"])\n    else:\n        L = 0\n        st = [p for p in ps if p[\"t\"] == \"start\"][0][\"at\"]\n        gt = [p for p in ps if p[\"t\"] == \"gate\"][0][\"at\"]\n        L = ((gt[0] - st[0]) ** 2 + (gt[1] - st[1]) ** 2) ** 0.5\n        title += \"straight  walked path %.1f m (start to gate)\" % (L / 100.0)\n        d.line([P(st[0], st[1]), P(gt[0], gt[1])], fill=(255, 220, 60), width=2)\n    d.text((10, 8), title, fill=(255, 255, 255), font=FONT)\n    d.text((10, 24), \"modules: \" + head.get(\"modules\", \"\")[:150], fill=(200, 200, 200), font=FONT)\n    bar = 1000 * s\n    d.line([(W - 20 - bar, 30), (W - 20, 30)], fill=(255, 255, 255), width=2)\n    d.text((W - 20 - bar, 34), \"10 m\", fill=(255, 255, 255), font=FONT)\n    return img\n\n\ndef main():\n    data = load_data()\n    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)\n    for seed in [int(a) for a in sys.argv[3:]]:\n        tiles = []\n        for depth in range(1, 13):\n            room, attempts, refused = make_room(data, seed, depth, 0, True, 1)\n            img = draw_stage(room[\"text\"], room[\"meta\"])\n            img.save(os.path.join(OUT, \"plan_s%d_d%02d.jpg\" % (seed, depth)), quality=88)\n            tiles.append(img)\n            m = room[\"meta\"]\n            print(\"s%d d%02d attempts=%d %s\" % (seed, depth, attempts,\n                  \"chambers=%d turns=%d path=%d hard=%d\" % (m[\"chambers\"], m[\"turns\"], m[\"path\"], m[\"hard\"]) if m.get(\"wound\") else \"straight\"))\n        tw = 320\n        th = 260\n        sheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (tw * 3, th * 4), (20, 20, 20))\n        for i, t in enumerate(tiles):\n            t2 = t.copy()\n            t2.thumbnail((tw - 4, th - 4))\n            sheet.paste(t2, ((i % 3) * tw + 2, (i // 3) * th + 2))\n        sheet.save(os.path.join(OUT, \"plan_s%d_sheet.jpg\" % seed), quality=88)\n\n\nmain()\n"
}

rebased or pushed. Clock times in [LOG.md](<[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/rebake1/LOG.md>).

## Changes that REBAKE.md did not foresee

1. **Game side.** `LoadedCatalogueHash()` calls `SupercutProps::Catalogue()` first, then reads the file's bytes once
   with `FFileHelper::LoadFileToArray` and keeps the hash. A file that cannot be read the second time is Fatal.
2. **Reader, `size=400,400,0`.** The three flat hall floor pieces have height 0. gen1's reader refused any 0. It now
   takes the game's own rule (`SupercutProps.cpp` 135-141): 0 only on a prop that does not block. This is outside
   what REBAKE.md allowed for; it reads a catalogue line the game accepts, it does not loosen a room check.
3. **Reader, `where=hall`.** The first bake put `hall_tarp_cover` (class cover, `blocks=1 open=0`, `where=hall`) in
   23 rooms as crate cover. `check_baked.py` passed them; the game refuses a hall piece in a run room
   (`SupercutRoomPieces.cpp` 114). The reader now checks a `where=hall` line and leaves it out, so the generator never
   picks one and the checker refuses one ("no prop in the catalogue"). The load line prints 117 props (125 less 8).
   The hash covers the whole file and is unchanged.
4. **Test.** The catalogue test pinned the stand-in file's hash `d1b1d697`, and REBAKE.md step 2 replaces that file.
   It now expects `cb703ef0`, and also checks that the game loaded that same hash, that a room with it reads and a
   room with another hash is refused. Nothing in it is weaker than before.

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- The scripted player

void ASupercutPlayerController::FailScript(const FString& Why)
{
	bScriptOver = true;
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Error, TEXT("SCRIPT failed at %.2f s: %s"), ScriptClock, *Why);
	ReportFps();
	if (bQuitAtEnd)
	{
		Quit(2);
	}
}

void ASupercutPlayerController::RunScript(float DeltaTime, FSupercutInput& Input, ASupercutCharacter* Hero, USupercutRun& Run)
{
	if (bScriptOver)
	{
		return;
	}

	if (Hero->IsDead() && !bDeathExpected)
	{
		FailScript(FString::Printf(TEXT("the player died (%s)"), *Hero->GetDeathCause()));
		return;
	}

	ScriptClock += DeltaTime;
	while (NextStep < Steps.Num() && Steps[NextStep].Time <= ScriptClock)
	{
		const FStep& Step = Steps[NextStep];
		if (Step.Command == TEXT("scene"))
		{
			if (Run.GetRoomEntries() == RoomEntriesSeen)
			{
				// Still in the old room, or on a screen between rooms. Wait here.
				SceneWait += DeltaTime;
				if (SceneWait > SceneWaitLimit)
				{
					FailScript(FString::Printf(TEXT("waited %.0f s at a \"scene\" line and the run did not enter a new room"), SceneWaitLimit));
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			const int32 WantScene = Step.Args.IsValidIndex(0) ? FCString::Atoi(*Step.Args[0]) : 0;
			const int32 WantTake = Step.Args.IsValidIndex(1) ? FCString::Atoi(*Step.Args[1]) : Run.GetTake();
			if (WantScene != Run.GetScene() || WantTake != Run.GetTake())
			{
				FailScript(FString::Printf(TEXT("the script expected scene %d take %d and the run is in scene %d take %d"), WantScene, WantTake, Run.GetScene(), Run.GetTake()));
				return;
			}
			RoomEntriesSeen = Run.GetRoomEntries();
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SCRIPT scene %d take %d entered after %.2f s, clock set to 0"), Run.GetScene(), Run.GetTake(), ScriptClock);
			ScriptClock = 0.f;
			SceneWait = 0.f;
			HeldForward = 0.f;
			HeldRight = 0.f;
			bHeldFire = false;
			bDeathExpected = false;
			++NextStep;
			continue;
		}

		RunStep(Step, Input, Hero);
		++NextStep;
		if (bScriptOver)
		{
			return;
		}
	}
	Input.Forward = HeldForward;
	Input.Right = HeldRight;
	Input.bFire = Input.bFire || bHeldFire;
}

def chamber_count(P, depth):
    return by_depth(P["wind"]["chambers"], depth)["n"]


def choose_chambers(data, rng, slot):
    """A list of chambers; each is {'kind', 'mods': [[name, form, enemies, filmcan], ...], 'mk'}."""
    P = data["plan"]
    W = P["wind"]
    depth = slot["depth"]
    n = chamber_count(P, depth)
    learned = list(slot["learned"])
    form = by_depth(P["level_by_depth"], depth)["form"]
    out = []
    if slot["lesson"] != "":
        out.append({"kind": slot["kind"], "mods": [[P["lessons"][slot["lesson"]]["module"], "lesson", [], 0]], "mk": 0})
        learned.append(slot["lesson"])     # taught in the first chamber, practised in the rest
    if slot["kind"] == "puzzle":
        tags = [t for t in P["tags"] if t in learned and t in P["practice_modules"]]
        last = out[-1]["mods"][0][0] if len(out) > 0 else ""
        while len(out) < n:
            name = rng.pick(P["practice_modules"][rng.pick(tags)])
            if name == last:
                name = rng.pick(P["practice_modules"][rng.pick(tags)])
            out.append({"kind": "puzzle", "mods": [[name, form, [], 0]], "mk": 0})
            last = name
        return out
    # A fight stage: arenas, each behind a screen flat at its door, some with a hazard before the fight.
    hazards = []
    for tag in ["fire", ""]:
        if tag == "" or tag in learned:
            for name in W["fight_hazards"][tag]:
                hazards.append(name)
    can = 1 if depth >= P["filmcan_from_depth"] else 0
    while len(out) < n:
        enemies = enemy_mix(P, rng, depth, slot["finale"], learned)
        enemies = enemies[0:W["arena_enemies_max"]]
        mods = [["arena", form, enemies, 1 if (can and rng.chance(1, 3)) else 0]]
        if rng.chance(W["hazard_odds"][0], W["hazard_odds"][1]):
            mods.insert(0, [rng.pick(hazards), form, [], 0])
        out.append({"kind": "fight", "mods": mods, "mk": 1})
    return out


def is_hard(chamber):
    """A fight that is hard without a freeze: two shooters, or a Rusher with a shooter behind it."""
    shooters = 0
    rushers = 0
    for m in chamber["mods"]:
        for k in m[2]:
            if k in SHOOTERS:
                shooters += 1
            elif k == "rusher":
                rushers += 1
    if chamber["mods"][0][0] in ["lesson_rusher", "lesson_marksman"]:
        return 0
    return 1 if shooters >= 2 or (rushers >= 1 and shooters >= 1) else 0

# SUPERCUT room generator: does the checker refuse unfair rooms?
#   python selftest.py
# Each case takes a fair generated room, breaks it in one way, and names the refusal the checker must give.
# A checker that passes everything proves nothing: this is the proof that it can say no.

import sys

from sc_build import load_data, build_room
from check import check_room

data = load_data()


def find_room(want, depth_from=1, depth_to=14, fight=None):
    """The first fair generated room (seed 1.., attempt 0) whose module list holds every name in want."""
    for seed in range(1, 400):
        for depth in range(depth_from, depth_to + 1):
            room = build_room(data, seed, depth, 0, 0, 0)     # no props: these cases break the layout
            names = [m[0] + "(" + m[1] + ")" for m in room["meta"]["modules"]]
            ok = 1
            for w in want:
                if len([n for n in names if n.startswith(w)]) == 0:
                    ok = 0
            if ok and check_room(room["text"], data)["ok"]:
                return room["text"]
    raise RuntimeError("no fair room with %s" % want)


def lines_of(text):
    return text.split("\n")


def drop(text, starts, count=99):
    """Remove up to count lines that start with the given words."""
    out = []
    for l in lines_of(text):
        if count > 0 and l.startswith(starts):
            count -= 1
            continue
        out.append(l)
    return "\n".join(out)


def swap(text, starts, old, new):
    out = []
    done = 0
    for l in lines_of(text):
        if not done and l.startswith(starts) and old in l:
            l = l.replace(old, new)
            done = 1
        out.append(l)
    if not done:
        raise RuntimeError("nothing to change: %s / %s" % (starts, old))
    return "\n".join(out)


def setting(text, starts, key):
    for l in lines_of(text):
        if l.startswith(starts):
            for w in l.split():
                if w.startswith(key + "="):
                    return w[len(key) + 1:]
    raise RuntimeError("no %s in a %s line" % (key, starts))


def add(text, line):
    return text + line + "\n"


cases = []


def case(name, code, text, with_data=None):
    cases.append([name, code, text, data if with_data is None else with_data])


blade = find_room(["blade_tunnel(lesson)"])
case("blade turns too slowly to block the tunnel", "blade", swap(blade, "blade ", "turns=1.5", "turns=0.5"))

import argparse
import glob
import os
import sys

from sc_build import load_data
from check import check_room


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--content", default=os.path.join("..", "..", "Content"))
    a = ap.parse_args()
    data = load_data()
    problems = 0
    rooms = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(a.content, "Rooms", "gen", "s*", "d*.txt")))
    with_props = 0
    for path in rooms:
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            text = f.read().decode("utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
        with_props += 1 if "\n# catalogue=" in text else 0
        r = check_room(text, data)
        if not r["ok"]:
            problems += 1
            print("REFUSED %s: %s" % (path, "; ".join(r["fails"])))
    runs = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(a.content, "Runs", "gen_s*.txt")))
    for path in runs:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            names = [l.split("#")[0].strip() for l in f.read().splitlines()]
        names = [n for n in names if n]
        missing = [n for n in names if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(a.content, "Rooms", n + ".txt"))]
        if len(names) != 12 or missing:
            problems += 1
            print("BAD RUN %s: %d rooms, missing %s" % (path, len(names), missing))
    print("%d rooms (%d with props, catalogue %s), %d runs, %d problems"
          % (len(rooms), with_props, data["catalogue_hash"], len(runs), problems))
    sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{
 "file_path": "[notes]\\unreal\\megajam-2026\\lanes\\gen3\\stage_stats.py",
 "content": "# gen3: per-stage numbers from a scripted run's log: time, shots, freezes, kills, health at the gate.\n#   python stage_stats.py run.log [more.log ...]\n# Time per stage is the frame count from one stage's start to the next one's (fixed 60 frames a second), upgrade\n# screen included. Shots are FIRE lines, freezes FREEZE begin lines, kills \"<ENEMY> n dies\" lines.\nimport re\nimport sys\n\n\ndef stats(path):\n    rows = []\n    cur = None\n    fps = 60.0\n    wrapped = \"\"\n    fail = \"\"\n    for line in open(path, encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\"):\n        m = re.match(r\"\\[[^\\]]*\\]\\[\\s*(\\d+)\\]\", line)\n        frame = int(m.group(1)) if m else None\n        if \"-FPS=\" in line and \"Command Line\" in line:\n            f = re.search(r\"-FPS=(\\d+)\", line)\n            if f:\n                fps = float(f.group(1))\n        if \"ROOM built\" in line or (\"RUN begins\" in line and cur is None):\n            if \"ROOM built\" in line and cur is not None and cur[\"built\"]:\n                pass\n            if cur is None or (\"ROOM built\" in line and cur[\"built\"]):\n                cur = {\"start\": frame, \"shots\": 0, \"freezes\": 0, \"kills\": 0, \"built\": False, \"end\": None}\n                rows.append(cur)\n            if \"ROOM built\" in line:\n                cur[\"built\"] = True\n        if cur is None:\n            continue\n        if \"Display: FIRE \" in line:\n            cur[\"shots\"] += 1\n        elif \"FREEZE begin\" in line:\n            cur[\"freezes\"] += 1\n        elif re.search(r\"Display: (GRUNT|RUSHER|MARKSMAN) \\d+ dies\", line):\n            cur[\"kills\"] += 1\n        elif \"END reached\" in line:\n            cur[\"end\"] = frame\n        elif \"RUN wrapped\" in line:\n            wrapped = line.split(\"Display: \")[-1].strip()\n        elif \"SCRIPT failed\" in line:\n            fail = line.split(\"Display: \")[-1].split(\"Error: \")[-1].strip()\n    return rows, fps, wrapped, fail\n\n\ndef main():\n    for path in sys.argv[1:]:\n        rows, fps, wrapped, fail = stats(path)\n        print(\"== %s\" % path)\n        print(\"stage  time_s  shots  freezes  kills\")\n        for i, r in enumerate(rows):\n            nxt = rows[i + 1][\"start\"] if i + 1 < len(rows) else r[\"end\"]\n            t = (nxt - r[\"start\"]) / fps if (nxt is not None and r[\"start\"] is not None) else float(\"nan\")\n            print(\"%5d  %6.1f  %5d  %7d  %5d\" % (i + 1, t, r[\"shots\"], r[\"freezes\"], r[\"kills\"]))\n        print(wrapped or \"(no RUN wrapped line)\")\n        if fail:\n            print(\"FAILED: \" + fail)\n\n\nmain()\n"
}

"""farm mirror: make <root>/Farm/<name> on a farm PC match a project folder on c4.

Sends only files whose size or modified time differ (tar keeps the times, so the next build is incremental), never
sends Intermediate, Binaries, Saved, DerivedDataCache or .git, and deletes files under Source, Content, Config, Tools
and Script that no longer exist on c4. Usage: python -I mirror.py <host> <root> <name> <project folder on c4>
"""
import os

import sys

SKIP = {"Intermediate", "Binaries", "Saved", "DerivedDataCache", ".git"}
PRUNE = ("Source/", "Content/", "Config/", "Tools/", "Script/")
TAR = r"C:\Windows\System32\tar.exe"


def ssh(host, cmd, data=None):
    r = subprocess.run(["ssh", host, cmd], input=data, capture_output=True)
    if r.returncode:
        sys.exit(f"FARM ssh {host} failed ({r.returncode}): {cmd}\n{r.stderr.decode(errors='replace')}")
    return r.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    host, root, name, proj = sys.argv[1:5]
    proj = os.path.abspath(proj)

        sys.exit(f"FARM no Supercut.uproject in {proj}")
    dest = f"{root}\\Farm\\{name}"

        remote[rel] = (int(size), int(mtime))
    local = {}
    for top in os.listdir(proj):
        if top in SKIP:
            continue
        p = os.path.join(proj, top)
        if os.path.isfile(p):
            st = os.stat(p)
            local[top] = (st.st_size, int(st.st_mtime))
            continue
        for d, dirs, files in os.walk(p):
            # Build outputs inside the project, at any depth (a plugin compiled on c4 leaves them under Plugins):
            # never sent. A plugin's Binaries\ThirdParty holds files it ships with and is sent.
            if os.path.basename(d) == "Binaries":
                dirs[:] = [x for x in dirs if x == "ThirdParty"]
                files = []
            dirs[:] = [x for x in dirs if x not in ("Intermediate", "Saved", "DerivedDataCache")]
            for f in files:
                full = os.path.join(d, f)
                st = os.stat(full)
                local[os.path.relpath(full, proj).replace("\\", "/")] = (st.st_size, int(st.st_mtime))

#
# Slots (15 Nov): build, test, package, package-shipping and run take one of the host's slots and wait for one

    pc4)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    c4)     echo 'D:\UE' ;;
    *) echo "FARM unknown host '$1' ([pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4, c4)" >&2; exit 64 ;;

slots_of() {  # heavy steps at once on each PC

  n=$(slots_of "$host"); mkdir -p "$lockdir"
  while :; do

    done
    [ "$waited" -eq 0 ] && echo "FARM $host is full ($n slot(s)); waiting. 'farm.sh slots' shows who holds them" >&2
    sleep 15; waited=$((waited + 15))

EOF

def scene(self, n):
        self.lines.append("0 scene %d 1" % n)
        self.t = 0.2

    def at_t(self, text):
        self.lines.append("%.2f %s" % (self.t, text))

    def now(self, text, dt=0.02):
        self.at_t(text)
        self.t += dt

    def wait(self, s):
        self.t += s

    def comment(self, text):
        self.lines.append("# " + text)


class Baker:
    def __init__(self, data, plan):
        self.data = data
        self.plan = plan
        self.zf = 0

    def goto(self, ch, v, near=40, secs=20, z=None):
        w = ch.world(v)
        self.plan.at_t("goto %d %d %d %d" % (w[0], w[1], near, secs))
        self.pos = [v[0], v[1]]

    def walk(self, ch, v, zf=None, near=40):
        zf = self.zf if zf is None else zf
        pts = ch.route(self.pos, v, zf)
        for k, p in enumerate(pts):
            self.goto(ch, p, near if k == len(pts) - 1 else 60)
        self.pos = [v[0], v[1]]

    def stop(self):
        self.plan.now("move 0 0", 0.25)

    # -------------------------------------------------------- module templates (own axes; x0 is the module's start)

        if ch.last:

        way, door = ch.exit

        enemies = [e for e in enemies if e[0] not in [m[0] for m in mine]]

                self.plan.now("clap", 0.05)

S="C:/Users/USER/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/ce66ae306241b5fa/79f751ca-dcd7-4e3e-92e4-815aa3ce264e/scratchpad"; cat > "$S/spare.py" <<'EOF'
# spare.py LOG: lowest health reached (and the scene), claps left at the end of each scene, any lethal-shot saves.
import re, sys
scene = 1; low = (100, 1); left = []; last = 3; saves = 0; hits = 0
for line in open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
    m = re.search(r"ROOM change: take \d+, scene (\d+) of", line)
    if m:
        if int(m.group(1)) != scene:
            left.append(last)
        scene = int(m.group(1)); last = 3
        continue
    m = re.search(r"PLAYER hit for \d+, health (-?\d+)", line)
    if m:
        hits += 1
        if int(m.group(1)) < low[0]:
            low = (int(m.group(1)), scene)
    m = re.search(r"charges (?:left )?(\d+)", line)
    if m and "ROOM change" not in line and "TAKE" not in line and "REFILL" not in line:
        last = int(m.group(1))
    if re.search(r"STUNT DOUBLE (?:saves|kept)|leaves 1 health\b(?!\.\")", line):
        saves += 1
    if "RUN wrapped" in line:
        left.append(last)
print("lowest health %d (scene %d), hits %d, claps left per scene %s (total %d of %d)" % (low[0], low[1], hits, left, sum(left), 3 * len(left)))
EOF
python -I "$S/spare.py" /d/UE/wt/gen3_farmlogs/keep/s7/run.log; grep -n "STUNT\|Stunt" /d/UE/wt/gen3/Source/Supercut/*.cpp | grep -i "log" | head -3

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Doorway heal (lane gen3)

ASupercutDoorHeal::ASupercutDoorHeal()
{
	PrimaryActorTick.bCanEverTick = true;
	RootComponent = CreateDefaultSubobject<USceneComponent>(TEXT("Root"));
}

void ASupercutDoorHeal::Tick(float DeltaSeconds)
{
	Super::Tick(DeltaSeconds);
	ASupercutCharacter* Hero = USupercutRun::Get(this).GetHero();
	if (bUsed || !Hero || Hero->IsDead())
	{
		return;
	}
	// Within 120 cm of the doorway's middle along the floor: a doorway is 150 to 200 wide, so any way through it.
	const FVector Offset = Hero->GetActorLocation() - GetActorLocation();
	if (Offset.Size2D() > 120.f || Offset.Z < 0.f || Offset.Z > Hero->GetCapsuleComponent()->GetScaledCapsuleHalfHeight() + 60.f)
	{
		return;
	}
	bUsed = true;
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("DOORWAY heal at %s"), *GetActorLocation().ToString());
	Hero->Heal(FSupercutTuning::Get().GateHeal);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Room file lines

// door id=word at=x,y,z facing=degrees width=cm height=cm

bClappedThisProgramRun = false;

bool ASupercutCharacter::Clap()
{
	if (bDead)
	{
		return false;
	}
	if (ClapMotion.IsBusy(FSupercutTuning::Get()))
	{
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("CLAP press %.3f s into the clap does nothing"), ClapMotion.GetClock());
		return false;
	}
	const bool bChanged = USupercutTime::Get(this).PressClapper();
	if (bChanged && !bClappedThisProgramRun)
	{
		bClappedThisProgramRun = true;
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("ONBOARD first clap of this program run: the RIGHT MOUSE prompt goes"));
	}
	if (!bChanged)
	{
		// No charges left: the board comes up, jams and drops (FSupercutClapMotion). The jam sounds clap_empty.
		ClapMotion.StartRefused();
		ClapSoundHook(TEXT("lift_whoosh"));
	}
	return bChanged;
}

#   farm.sh package-shipping <host> <name> <log folder>      Tools\package_shipping.cmd -> ...\_builds\<name>\Supercut59_ship

#
# Slots (15 Nov): build, test, package, package-shipping and run take one of the host's slots and wait for one

    [pc-c])   echo 'F:\UE' ;;
    pc4)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;

def bake_stage(data, plan, text, scene, shots=False):
    chambers, enemies = stage_chambers(data, text)
    b = Baker(data, plan)
    if scene > 1:
        plan.scene(scene)
    plan.comment("stage %d: %s" % (scene, text.split("\n")[2][2:]))
    plan.now("reload", 0.05)
    for ch in chambers:
        mine = []
        for e in enemies:
            lv = ch.local(e[2])
            if -60 <= lv[0] <= ch.L + 60 and -ch.hw <= lv[1] <= ch.hw and abs(e[2][2] - ch.zo) < 800:
                roam = []
                for h in e[3]:
                    hv = ch.local(h)
                    roam.append([hv[0], hv[1], h[2] - ch.zo])
                mine.append((e[0], e[1], [lv[0], lv[1], e[2][2] - ch.zo], roam))
        if ch.i == 0:
            st = ch.of("start")[0]["at"]
            entry = [st[0], st[1]]
            if shots:
                plan.now("shot gen3_d%02d_start" % scene, 0.3)
        else:
            entry = [70, ch.ys]
            b.goto(ch, [-40, ch.ys], 50)
            b.goto(ch, entry, 40)
            if shots:
                # in the doorway, looking into the chamber along its own axis
                b.stop()
                w = ch.world([900, ch.ys], EYE)
                plan.now("lookat %d %d %d" % (w[0], w[1], w[2] - 20), 0.3)
                plan.now("shot gen3_d%02d_door%d" % (scene, ch.i), 0.3)
        b.chamber(ch, mine, entry)
        enemies = [e for e in enemies if e[0] not in [m[0] for m in mine]]
    if enemies:
        raise BakeError("enemies %s are in no chamber" % [e[0] for e in enemies])

Result:

```
*
 * Script lines are "<seconds> <command> [words]". The clock starts when the script does and runs
 * through the upgrade and wrap screens. A "scene" line sets it back to zero. Commands:
 *   move <forward> <right>   hold the move keys (-1 to 1 each) until the next move line
 *   look <yaw> <pitch>       point the view (degrees)
 *   lookat <x> <y> <z>       point the view at a place in the room
 *   aim <enemy index>        point the view at an enemy's chest. Enemies of every kind are numbered 0, 1, 2 in the order of their room file lines
 *   jump | fire | clap | reload   one press
 *   firehold <0 or 1>        hold or release the trigger
 *   key <key name>           press and let go of a real key, by the engine's name for it (One, Two, Three, SpaceBar, ...)
 *   click <x> <y>            a mouse click at a place on the screen, each 0 to 1 from the top left. The menu screens and the upgrade screen take clicks.
 *   point <x> <y>            the mouse moves to a place on the screen (as click): the menu marks what is under it
 *   scene <n> [take]         wait until the run enters its next room, check it is scene n (and that take), set the clock to 0.
 *                            The seconds written on a scene line are not used: write 0.
 *   expectdeath              the player is meant to die before the next "scene" line; without this a death fails the script
 *   shot <name>              save a picture
 *   mouse <x> <y>            turn the view as the mouse would by x and y engine mouse units (LookDegreesPerMouseUnit() applies)
 *   report                   log the tuned numbers where they are used: walk speed, view angle, freeze length, charges, look speed, enemy health
 *   end                      the script is over
 *
 * Started with -SupercutDev, the practice keys F1 to F9 work (USupercutPractice), from real keys or "key F2" lines.

// A doorway of a winding stage (lane gen3): walking through it gives the gate's heal (GateHeal) and one charge back,
// once, since a winding stage holds several fights or puzzles and only one gate.
UCLASS()
class ASupercutDoorHeal : public AActor
{
	GENERATED_BODY()

public:
	ASupercutDoorHeal();

	virtual void Tick(float DeltaSeconds) override;

	bool IsUsed() const { return bUsed; }

private:
	bool bUsed = false;
};
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Doorway heal (lane gen3)

ASupercutDoorHeal::ASupercutDoorHeal()
{
	PrimaryActorTick.bCanEverTick = true;
	RootComponent = CreateDefaultSubobject<USceneComponent>(TEXT("Root"));
}

void ASupercutDoorHeal::Tick(float DeltaSeconds)
{
	Super::Tick(DeltaSeconds);
	ASupercutCharacter* Hero = USupercutRun::Get(this).GetHero();
	if (bUsed || !Hero || Hero->IsDead())
	{
		return;
	}
	// Within 120 cm of the doorway's middle along the floor: a doorway is 150 to 200 wide, so any way through it.
	const FVector Offset = Hero->GetActorLocation() - GetActorLocation();
	if (Offset.Size2D() > 120.f || Offset.Z < 0.f || Offset.Z > Hero->GetCapsuleComponent()->GetScaledCapsuleHalfHeight() + 60.f)
	{
		return;
	}
	bUsed = true;
	USupercutTime& Time = USupercutTime::Get(this);
	Time.AddCharge();
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("DOORWAY heal and a charge at %s, charges %d of %d"), *GetActorLocation().ToString(), Time.GetCharges(), Time.GetMaxCharges());
	Hero->Heal(FSupercutTuning::Get().GateHeal);
}

		if (!Step.Args.IsValidIndex(1))

			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("SCRIPT: \"goto\" at %.2f needs X and Y"), Step.Time);

		const FVector2D Target(Number(0, 0.f), Number(1, 0.f));

static FSupercutPieceType GStartPiece(TEXT("start"), ESupercutPieceCount::ExactlyOne, [](FSupercutPieceReader& In) -> FSupercutPieceBuild
{
	const FVector At = In.Vector(TEXT("at"));
	const float Facing = In.Number(TEXT("facing"));
	return [=](ASupercutRoom& Room)
	{
		Room.SetStart(At, Facing);
		UMaterialInterface* Tape = Room.RoleMaterial(TEXT("tape"));
		Room.AddShape(ESupercutShape::Cube, At + FVector(0.f, 0.f, 0.6f), FRotator(0.f, Facing + 45.f, 0.f), FVector(130.f, 10.f, 1.2f), Tape, false);
		Room.AddShape(ESupercutShape::Cube, At + FVector(0.f, 0.f, 0.6f), FRotator(0.f, Facing - 45.f, 0.f), FVector(130.f, 10.f, 1.2f), Tape, false);
	};
});

// The end of the room: a point on the floor. Standing on it ends the room. Draws a disc and a frame
// 300 wide and 304 high, green when open and red while an enemy of the room lives. facing is the way
// the player walks through it.
static FSupercutPieceType GGatePiece(TEXT("gate"), ESupercutPieceCount::ExactlyOne, [](FSupercutPieceReader& In) -> FSupercutPieceBuild
{
	const FVector At = In.Vector(TEXT("at"));
	const float Facing = In.Number(TEXT("facing"));
	return [=](ASupercutRoom& Room)

In a fight stage a masking flat (`box role=flat`, 60 x 400, 220 high, solid)\nstands 380 to 440 inside each later chamber's doorway, across the way in, with clear floor either side.\n\n**What a path-finder may trip over.**\n- Floors are many boxes. Each module lays its own floor box end to end with the next, and carve_pits cuts a floor\n  into up to four boxes round each opening. // The room is not part of the frozen scene: these checks run in real time.
	ASupercutCharacter* Hero = USupercutRun::Get(this).GetHero();
	if (!Hero || Hero->IsDead() || bGateReached)
	{
		return;
	}

	const FVector At = Hero->GetActorLocation();
	if (At.Z < FallHeight)
	{
		Hero->Kill(TEXT("fell"));
		return;
	}

	const UCapsuleComponent* Capsule = Hero->GetCapsuleComponent();
	const float Radius = Capsule->GetScaledCapsuleRadius();
	const float HalfHeight = Capsule->GetScaledCapsuleHalfHeight();
	for (const FKillBox& Kill : KillBoxes)
	{
		// Lava reaches LavaReach along the floor; every other kill box reaches the body's radius.
		const float Side = Kill.Cause == TEXT("lava") ? FSupercutTuning::Get().LavaReach : Radius;
		const FVector Reach(Side, Side, HalfHeight);
		if (Kill.Box.Intersect(FBox(At - Reach, At + Reach)))
		{
			Hero->Kill(*Kill.Cause);
			return;
		}
	}

	OpenGateIfClear();
	if (bGateLocked)
	{
		return;   // reaching a locked gate does nothing
	}

	const FVector Offset = At - Gate;
	if (Offset.Size2D() < FSupercutTuning::Get().GateRadius && Offset.Z > 0.f)
	{
		bGateReached = true;
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("END reached: the player is at the end marker"));
	}

{
	auto Number = [&Step](int32 Index)
	{
		if (!Step.Args.IsValidIndex(Index))
		{
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("SCRIPT: \"%s\" at %.2f needs %d numbers"), *Step.Command, Step.Time, Index + 1);
		}
		return FCString::Atof(*Step.Args[Index]);
	};

	const FVector At = Hero->GetActorLocation();
	FString Note;

	if (Step.Command == TEXT("move"))
	{
		HeldForward = Number(0);
		HeldRight = Number(1);
	}
	else if (Step.Command == TEXT("look"))
	{
		SetControlRotation(FRotator(Number(1), Number(0), 0.f));
	}
	else if (Step.Command == TEXT("lookat"))
	{
		LookAt(FVector(Number(0), Number(1), Number(2)), Hero);
	}
	else if (Step.Command == TEXT("fly"))

	RoomEntriesSeen = Run.GetRoomEntries();

	FString ScriptPath;
	if (FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("-SupercutScript="), ScriptPath))
	{
		LoadScript(ScriptPath);
	}
	if (FParse::Value(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("-SupercutShots="), ShotFolder))
	{
		IFileManager::Get().MakeDirectory(*ShotFolder, true);
	}
	bCountFps = FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("SupercutFps"));
	bQuitAtEnd = FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("SupercutQuit"));
	bTrace = FParse::Param(FCommandLine::Get(), TEXT("SupercutTrace"));

	// The engine applied the saved window and quality at start. The volumes, the unfocused mute and the colour filter are the game's own.
	USupercutUserSettings& Settings = USupercutUserSettings::Get();
	USupercutMenu::Get(this).ApplyLive();
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SETTINGS at start: %s"), *Settings.Describe());
	SupercutDlss::Apply(Settings.GetDlssMode());
	if (Run.GetPhase() == ESupercutRunPhase::Title)
	{
		Settings.ChooseQualityOnFirstStart();
		USupercutMenu::Get(this).ShowTitle();
	}

	if (!bScripted)
	{
		// A person is playing: the game takes the mouse. A run started with a script never does,
		// so it cannot grab the mouse of whoever is at the PC.
		SetInputMode(FInputModeGameOnly());
		bShowMouseCursor = false;
	}
}

void ASupercutPlayerController::LoadScript(const FString& Path)
{
	TArray<FString> Lines;
	if (!FFileHelper::LoadFileToStringArray(Lines, *Path))
	{
		UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("-SupercutScript: cannot read %s"), *Path);
	}
	for (const FString& Raw : Lines)
	{
		const FString Line = Raw.TrimStartAndEnd();
		if (Line.IsEmpty() || Line.StartsWith(TEXT("#")))
		{
			continue;
		}
		TArray<FString> Words;
		Line.ParseIntoArrayWS(Words);
		if (Words.Num() < 2)
		{
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("-SupercutScript: bad line \"%s\" in %s"), *Line, *Path);
		}
		FStep Step;
		Step.Time = FCString::Atof(*Words[0]);
		Step.Command = Words[1].ToLower();
		for (int32 Index = 2; Index < Words.Num(); ++Index)
		{
			Step.Args.Add(Words[Index]);
		}
		Steps.Add(Step);
	}
	bScripted = true;
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("SCRIPT loaded: %d steps from %s"), Steps.Num(), *Path);
}

    def grid(self, zf):
        if zf in self.grids:
            return self.grids[zf]
        free = np.zeros((self.nx, self.ny), dtype=bool)
        block = np.zeros((self.nx, self.ny), dtype=bool)

        def span(a0, a1, o, n, pad):
            i0 = max(0, int(math.floor((a0 - pad - o) / CELL)))
            i1 = min(n - 1, int(math.ceil((a1 + pad - o) / CELL)))
            return i0, i1

        for b in self.solids:
            top = b[5]
            if abs(top - zf) <= STEP and b[2] < zf:
                # something to stand on (centre of the cell on it)
                i0, i1 = span(b[0], b[3], self.x0, self.nx, -CELL / 2)
                j0, j1 = span(b[1], b[4], self.y0, self.ny, -CELL / 2)
                free[i0:i1 + 1, j0:j1 + 1] = True
        for b in self.solids:
            if b[2] < zf + HEAD and b[5] > zf + STEP:
                i0, i1 = span(b[0], b[3], self.x0, self.nx, R)

                block[i0:i1 + 1, j0:j1 + 1] = True
        g = free & ~block

class Chamber:
    def __init__(self, data, info, index, last):
        self.i = index
        self.last = last
        self.O = info["O"]
        self.d = info["d"]
        self.zo = info["zo"]
        self.hw = info["hw"]
        self.L = info["length"]
        self.ys = info["ys"]
        self.yg = info["yg"]
        self.z_exit = info["z_exit"]
        self.segs = info["segs"]
        self.kind = info["kind"]
        self.exit = info["exit"]
        self.pieces = [p for p in info["pieces"] if p["t"] not in ("fall", "keylight")]
        cat = {q["name"]: q for q in data["catalogue"]}
        self.solids = [p["from"] + p["to"] for p in self.pieces if p["t"] == "box"]
        self.sight = list(self.solids)
        for p in info["dress"]:
            q = cat[p["name"]]
            if q["blocks"] == 1:
                b = dress_box(p["at"], q["size"], p["turn"], q["from"])
                self.solids.append(b)
                if q["open"] == 0:
                    self.sight.append(b)
        # A shot leaves the gun, not the eye, and spreads: a place counts as seeing an enemy only past a margin
        # (and the gun sits below the eye, so a shot down past an edge clips it: tops count 40 cm higher)
        self.sight_fat = [[b[0] - SHOT_MARGIN, b[1] - SHOT_MARGIN, b[2], b[3] + SHOT_MARGIN, b[4] + SHOT_MARGIN, b[5] + 40]
                          for b in self.sight]
        self.lava = [p["from"] + p["to"] for p in self.pieces if p["t"] == "kill"]
        self.x0 = -150
        self.y0 = -self.hw - 60
        self.nx = (self.L + 300) // CELL + 1
        self.ny = (2 * self.hw + 120) // CELL + 1
        self.grids = {}

    def world(self, v, z=None):
        w = turn_xy([v[0], v[1]], self.d)
        out = [self.O[0] + w[0], self.O[1] + w[1]]
        if z is not None:
            out.append(self.zo + z)
        return out

    def local(self, w):
        dx, dy = w[0] - self.O[0], w[1] - self.O[1]
        # inverse of turn_xy: own x along d, own y along d turned left
        return [dx * self.d[0] + dy * self.d[1], -dx * self.d[1] + dy * self.d[0]]

    def of(self, t, x0=None, x1=None):
        out = []
        for p in self.pieces:
            if p["t"] != t:
                continue
            at = p["at"] if "at" in p else p["from"]
            if x0 is not None and not (x0 <= at[0] <= x1):
                continue
            out.append(p)
        return out

class Baker:
    def __init__(self, data, plan):
        self.data = data
        self.plan = plan
        self.zf = 0
        self.charges = int(T["Charges"])   # the board as the game keeps it (USupercutTime), without upgrades
        self.reserve = 0                   # charges the rest of this chamber's machines need

    def clap(self, dt):
        """A machine's clap: it must have a charge, or the stage cannot be played as planned."""
        if self.charges <= 0:
            raise BakeError("a machine needs a clap and the board is empty")
        self.charges -= 1
        self.plan.now("clap", dt)

    def goto(self, ch, v, near=40, secs=20, z=None):
        w = ch.world(v)
        self.plan.at_t("goto %d %d %d %d" % (w[0], w[1], near, secs))
        self.pos = [v[0], v[1]]

    def walk(self, ch, v, zf=None, near=40):
        zf = self.zf if zf is None else zf
        pts = ch.route(self.pos, v, zf)
        for k, p in enumerate(pts):
            self.goto(ch, p, near if k == len(pts) - 1 else 60)
        self.pos = [v[0], v[1]]

    def stop(self):
        self.plan.now("move 0 0", 0.25)

    # -------------------------------------------------------- module templates (own axes; x0 is the module's start)

    def lane(self, ch, y):
        return max(-ch.hw + 150, min(ch.hw - 150, y))

    def t_dolly_pit(self, ch, s):
        p = ch.of("platform", s["x0"], s["x1"])[0]
        px = p["from"][0]
        y = (p["from"][1] + p["to"][1]) / 2
        bank = s["x0"] + 300
        far = s["x1"] - 300
        self.walk(ch, [s["x0"] + 40, y])
        self.stop()
        w = ch.world([px, y])
        self.plan.at_t("when platform %d %d 40 20" % (w[0], w[1]))
        self.clap(0.05)
        self.goto(ch, [bank - 30, y], 20)
        self.plan.at_t("jump")
        self.goto(ch, [px + 170, y], 25)
        self.plan.at_t("jump")
        self.goto(ch, [far + 200, y], 50)

    def t_ferry(self, ch, s):
        p = ch.of("platform", s["x0"], s["x1"])[0]
        a, b = p["from"], p["to"]
        if a[0] > b[0]:
            a, b = b, a
        y = a[1]
        self.walk(ch, [s["x0"] + 220, y])

        wb = ch.world([b[0], y])

        self.goto(ch, [a[0] + 20, y], 60)
        self.stop()
        self.plan.at_t("when platform %d %d 30 20" % (wb[0], wb[1]))
        self.goto(ch, [s["x1"] - 100, y], 50)

void ASupercutPlatform::BeginPlay()
{
	Super::BeginPlay();

	UMaterialInterface* Top = SupercutShapes::Solid(this, FLinearColor(0.85f, 0.6f, 0.08f), 0.6f);
	UMaterialInterface* Rim = SupercutShapes::Glow(this, FLinearColor(1.f, 0.75f, 0.15f), 6.f);
	Deck = SupercutShapes::Add(this, RootComponent, ESupercutShape::Cube, FVector::ZeroVector, FRotator::ZeroRotator, SizeCm, Top, TEXT("BlockAllDynamic"));
	SupercutShapes::Add(this, RootComponent, ESupercutShape::Cube, FVector(0.f, 0.f, -SizeCm.Z * 0.5f - 3.f), FRotator::ZeroRotator, FVector(SizeCm.X + 8.f, SizeCm.Y + 8.f, 6.f), Rim);

	USupercutAudio::Get(this).PlayOn(TEXT("platform_loop"), RootComponent);   // it never stops moving
	USupercutTime::Get(this).JoinScene(this);
}

FVector ASupercutPlatform::LocationAt(float AtClock) const
{
	const float Length = FVector::Dist(A, B);
	if (Length <= KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER)
	{
		return A;
	}
	// A triangle wave: out at a steady speed, back at the same speed.
	const float Along = FMath::Fmod(AtClock * Speed, 2.f * Length);
	const float Alpha = (Along <= Length ? Along : 2.f * Length - Along) / Length;
	return FMath::Lerp(A, B, Alpha);
}

void ASupercutPlatform::Tick(float DeltaSeconds)
{
	Super::Tick(DeltaSeconds);
	if (DeltaSeconds <= 0.f)
	{
		return;   // frozen: holds its place
	}
	Clock += DeltaSeconds;
	SetActorLocation(LocationAt(Clock));
}

def chamber(self, ch, enemies, entry):
        self.zf = 0
        self.pos = entry
        self.plan.comment("chamber %d: %s" % (ch.i, " ".join(s["name"] for s in ch.segs)))
        if ch.kind == "puzzle":
            pads = ch.of("refill")
            if pads:
                # a pad does nothing in a freeze and works on the step onto it (SupercutPuzzles.cpp ASupercutRefill):
                # stop outside its reach, wait for time to roll, then step on
                self.walk(ch, pads[0]["at"][:2], near=int(T["RefillReach"]) + 80)
                self.plan.now("when rolling 10", 0.05)
                self.goto(ch, pads[0]["at"][:2], 30)
                self.pos = list(pads[0]["at"][:2])
                self.plan.wait(0.1)
                self.charges = int(T["Charges"])
        claps = ("blade_tunnel", "bar_bridge", "crate_bridge", "timed_door", "dolly_pit")
        for k, s in enumerate(ch.segs):
            self.reserve = sum(1 for q in ch.segs[k:] if q["name"] in claps)
            name = s["name"]
            self.zf = s["z0"] if name not in ("climb", "crate_bridge") else self.zf
            mine = [e for e in enemies if s["x0"] - 100 <= e[2][0] <= s["x1"] + 100]
            if mine:
                self.fight(ch, s, mine)
                enemies = [e for e in enemies if e not in mine]
            fn = {"blade_tunnel": self.t_blade_tunnel, "bar_bridge": self.t_bar_bridge,
                  "crate_bridge": self.t_crate_bridge, "timed_door": self.t_timed_door, "fire_strip": self.t_fire,
                  "fire_double": self.t_fire, "fire_gap": self.t_fire, "climb": self.t_climb,
                  "lava_hops": self.t_lava_hops, "dolly_pit": self.t_dolly_pit, "ferry": self.t_ferry}.get(name)
            if fn:
                fn(ch, s)
            self.zf = s["z1"]
        if enemies:
            self.reserve = 0
            self.fight(ch, ch.segs[-1], enemies)
        if ch.last:
            # The gate's trigger ends the stage about 1.2 m before the gate's own spot, and the player stops there, so
            # a goto to the gate never arrives. Walk to 2 m short, face along the gate (it faces +x in its own axes),
            # then hold forward into it.

            w = ch.world([g[0] + 400, g[1]], EYE)
            self.plan.now("lookat %d %d %d" % (w[0], w[1], w[2]), 0.05)
            self.plan.now("move 1 0", 0.9)
            self.stop()
            return No

*   -SupercutScript=<file>  a scripted player: a text file of timed inputs replaces the keyboard and mouse
 *   -SupercutShots=<folder> the script's "shot <name>" lines save <folder>/<name>.png
 *   -SupercutFps            log the frame rate, split into rolling and frozen time
 *   -SupercutQuit           quit when the script ends (exit code 0), or when it fails (exit code 2)
 *   -SupercutTrace          log the player's place, view, rounds and charges twice a second (for checking real keys and mouse)
 *
 * Script lines are "<seconds> <command> [words]". The clock starts when the script does and runs
 * through the upgrade and wrap screens. A "scene" line sets it back to zero. Commands:
 *   move <forward> <right>   hold the move keys (-1 to 1 each) until the next move line
 *   look <yaw> <pitch>       point the view (degrees)
 *   lookat <x> <y> <z>       point the view at a place in the room
 *   fly <x> <y> <z>          put the player's eye at a place and hold it there (flying, no gravity): for pictures only
 *   aim <enemy index>        point the view at an enemy's chest. Enemies of every kind are numbered 0, 1, 2 in the order of their room file lines
 *   jump | fire | clap | reload   one press
 *   clap 1                   a clap only while time rolls: nothing while a freeze runs (a second press would end it)
 *   firehold <0 or 1>        hold or release the trigger
 *   key <key name>           press and let go of a real key, by the engine's name for it (One, Two, Three, SpaceBar, ...)
 *   click <x> <y>            a mouse click at a place on the screen, each 0 to 1 from the top left. The menu screens and the upgrade screen take clicks.
 *   point <x> <y>            the mouse moves to a place on the screen (as click): the menu marks what is under it
 *   scene <n> [take]         wait until the run enters its next room, check it is scene n (and that take), set the clock to 0.
 *                            The seconds written on a scene line are not used: write 0.
 *   expectdeath              the player is meant to die before the next "scene" line; without this a death fails the script

 *   mouse <x> <y>            turn the view as the mouse would by x and y engine mouse units (LookDegreesPerMouseUnit() applies)

		{
			if (!CreateTestWorld(EWorldType::Game))
			{
				return false;
			}
			GetTestWorld()->GetWorldSettings()->DefaultGameMode = AGameModeBase::StaticClass();
			if (!BeginPlayInTestWorld())
			{
				return false;
			}
			FActorSpawnParameters Params;
			Params.SpawnCollisionHandlingOverride = ESpawnActorCollisionHandlingMethod::AlwaysSpawn;
			Controller = GetTestWorld()->SpawnActor<ASupercutPlayerController>(FVector::ZeroVector, FRotator::ZeroRotator, Params);
			Controller->SetAsLocalPlayerController();
			USupercutRun::Get(GetTestWorld()).Begin({ TEXT("tests/plain") }, 1);
			return Hero() && Hero()->GetController() == Controller;

  `D:\UE\Farm\_locks\<host>.<i>` (file `owner`: pid, name, step, start) and wait inside the call when none is free.

  `farm.sh slots` lists the holders. The load check in "Before a heavy step" is no longer needed for lanes; the

            break

Lane `loop1` owns the run's rules (no reset, the endless run, inserting a rest scene as every 5th scene, picking it from `Content\Rooms\rest\*.txt`; it writes a plain `rest\01.txt` by hand as a stand-in). 1. **More refills in generated rooms.** Today a room has about 3 `refill` lines. Charges will no longer reset at a scene's start, so the rooms must carry the player. `[pick]`: one refill per fight pocket or chamber, placed before it on the route and in sight from the way in, plus one per 12 m of route between pockets, never fewer than 4 in a room and never more than 8. Not in a pit's kill box, not behind a masking flat's blind side, not inside a blade's sweep, reachable without a jump unless the route itself needs that jump. Add the count and the placement rule to the generator's own checks, and report refills per room over the 50 runs (min, median, max).

// A refill pad puts a puzzle back to its start. A fight cannot be put back, so a room has one or the other.
static FSupercutRoomRule GRefillRule([](FSupercutRoomCheck& Room)
{
	const TArray<const FSupercutRoomNote*> Enemies = Room.Notes(TEXT("enemy"));
	if (Enemies.Num() == 0)
	{
		return;
	}
	for (const FSupercutRoomNote* Pad : Room.Notes(TEXT("refill")))
	{
		Room.Fail(*Pad, FString::Printf(TEXT("a room with a refill pad cannot have enemies, and line %d has a %s"), Enemies[0]->Line, *Enemies[0]->Type));
	}
});

# SUPERCUT room generator: the fairness checker.
#   python check.py room SEED DEPTH [--attempt A] [--known N]     check one room and say why
#   python check.py file PATH                                     check a room file
# check_room(text, data) reads the room TEXT back and refuses the room unless every rule holds.
# Whole numbers only (cm, ms), no dict or set order decides anything: the C++ port must give the same verdicts,
# because a refused room makes the generator build the next attempt.
#
# The model, in short:
#   A grid of 40 cm cells. A node is a place the player's capsule (radius 34, height 176) can stand: a cell centre
#   on top of a floor, stage or apple box, with nothing solid in the capsule's space.
#   Nodes joined by walking (step up to 45) form a region. Regions are joined by jumps and drops (one way each).
#   The jump the checker allows is 280 cm level (the real one is 403), less when it also climbs, 100 cm up at most.
#   Doors, blades, platforms and falling crates add links that cost a clap, found by trying clap times.
#   Then a search over (region, charges 0..3) proves the gate can be reached from every state.

# Replica of SupercutHall.cpp:224-256 with the studio of SupercutRoom.cpp:319-436 (solid boxes only; props ignored,
# they only widen the model). Prints the four slacks in cm; the game needs every one >= 0.
import math, re, sys, glob
CELL = 400.0
def down(v): return math.floor(v / CELL) * CELL
def up(v): return math.ceil(v / CELL) * CELL
def slack(path):
    lo = [1e9] * 3; hi = [-1e9] * 3
    for line in open(path):
        m = re.match(r"\s*box\s.*from=(-?\d+),(-?\d+),(-?\d+)\s+to=(-?\d+),(-?\d+),(-?\d+)", line)
        if m:
            v = list(map(float, m.groups()))
            for i in range(3):
                lo[i] = min(lo[i], v[i], v[i + 3]); hi[i] = max(hi[i], v[i], v[i + 3])
    mid = [(lo[i] + hi[i]) / 2 for i in range(3)]
    r = 0.5 * math.sqrt(sum((hi[i] - lo[i]) ** 2 for i in range(3)))
    out = 1.4 * r * 1.6
    smin = [mid[0] - out, mid[1] - out]; smax = [mid[0] + out, mid[1] + out]
    gmin = [down(lo[0] - 400 - 50), down(lo[1] - 400 - 50)]
    gmax = [up(hi[0] + 400 + 50), up(hi[1] + 400 + 50)]
    x0 = up(smin[0] + 60); y0 = up(smin[1] + 60); x1 = down(smax[0] - 60); y1 = down(smax[1] - 60)
    return [gmin[0] - x0 - CELL, gmin[1] - y0 - CELL, x1 - gmax[0] - CELL, y1 - gmax[1] - CELL]
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(p)):
        s = slack(f)
        print("%-40s %s %s" % (f.split("Rooms/")[-1], " ".join("%5.0f" % v for v in s), "ok" if min(s) >= 0 else "FAILS"))
EOF

14: * Turns keys and the mouse into one FSupercutInput a frame and hands it to the character.
15: * Keys are read directly (W A S D, Space, mouse buttons, R, Esc), so the game needs no input assets.
16: * On the upgrade screen it takes keys 1, 2, 3 or a click on a card. On the wrap screen any key but Esc starts a new run.
17: * Esc opens the pause screen; the title, pause, settings and controls screens (USupercutMenu) take the keys and clicks first.
18: *
19: * Switches, read from the command line in every build (Shipping too, so its build can be checked with a script):
20: *   -SupercutScript=<file>  a scripted player: a text file of timed inputs replaces the keyboard and mouse
21: *   -SupercutShots=<folder> the script's "shot <name>" lines save <folder>/<name>.png
22: *   -SupercutFps            log the frame rate, split into rolling and frozen time
23: *   -SupercutQuit           quit when the script ends (exit code 0), or when it fails (exit code 2)
24: *   -SupercutTrace          log the player's place, view, rounds and charges twice a second (for checking real keys and mouse)
25: *
26: * Script lines are "<seconds> <command> [words]". The clock starts when the script does and runs
27: * through the upgrade and wrap screens. A "scene" line sets it back to zero. Commands:
28: *   move <forward> <right>   hold the move keys (-1 to 1 each) until the next move line
29: *   look <yaw> <pitch>       point the view (degrees)
30: *   lookat <x> <y> <z>       point the view at a place in the room
31: *   fly <x> <y> <z>          put the player's eye at a place and hold it there (flying, no gravity): for pictures only
32: *   aim <enemy index>        point the view at an enemy's chest. Enemies of every kind are numbered 0, 1, 2 in the order of their room file lines
33: *   jump | fire | clap | reload   one press
34: *   clap 1                   a clap only while time rolls: nothing while a freeze runs (a second press would end it)
35: *   clear                    remove every enemy of the room at once (ClearRoomForScript): the room's own rule opens its gate.
36: *                            For geometry walks that prove a room can be walked whatever the enemies do
37: *   firehold <0 or 1>        hold or release the trigger
38: *   key <key name>           press and let go of a real key, by the engine's name for it (One, Two, Three, SpaceBar, ...)
39: *   click <x> <y>            a mouse click at a place on the screen, each 0 to 1 from the top left. The menu s

#!/bin/bash
# runq4.sh <tag> <run args...> : one farm run on c4 for gen4, logs kept in $L/keep/<tag>/; prints the outcome line.
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"; L=/d/UE/wt/gen4_farmlogs
tag=$1; shift
"$F" run c4 gen4 "$L" -Packaged -Exe '{B}\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut.exe' "$@" > "$L/x_$tag.txt" 2>&1; c=$?
rm -rf "$L/keep/$tag"; mkdir -p "$L/keep"; cp -r "$L/run" "$L/keep/$tag" 2>/dev/null
log=$(ls "$L/keep/$tag"/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -1)
w=$(grep -ah "RUN wrapped" "$log" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | sed 's/.*Display: //')
f=$(grep -ah "SCRIPT failed\|timed out\|Fatal error\|SCRIPT: " "$log" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/.*: Error: //;s/.*Display: //' | cut -c1-220)
sc=$(grep -aoh "scene [0-9]* of [0-9]*" "$log" 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
mu=$(grep -ac "missing usage flag" "$log" 2>/dev/null)
echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) $tag code $c | ${w:-no wrap} | last ${sc:-scene 1} | usage-flag $mu | ${f}"
```

    sets = {}
    if "forms" in mod and form in mod["forms"]:
        sets = mod["forms"][form]["set"]
    for p in mod["params"]:
        spec = sets.get(p["n"], p)
        if "pick" in spec:

        elif "range" in spec:
            lo = ev(spec["range"][0], scope)
            hi = ev(spec["range"][1], scope)
            value = rng.between(lo, hi, spec["range"][2])
        else:
            value = ev(spec["v"], scope)
        scope[p["n"]] = value

Lane gen2, 14 Nov 2026. For after lane props1's branch is merged: it adds the prop catalogue
`Content/Props/catalogue.txt` and the loader that places `dress name=... at=... turn=...` lines from it.

## 1. Before baking: the game side

1. In `Source/Supercut/SupercutGeneratedRuns.cpp`, `LoadedCatalogueHash()` returns "no catalogue" today. Make it
   return the hash of the catalogue file the loader read:

   ```cpp
   return SupercutGeneratedRuns::CatalogueHash(<the bytes of Content/Props/catalogue.txt the loader read>);
   ```

   If the loader keeps only parsed lines, read the file's bytes once more there with `FFileHelper::LoadFileToArray`.
   Until this line changes, every room with a `# catalogue=` line is refused at load in a Development build.
2. Check that the catalogue is staged in a package (`Config/DefaultGame.ini`: `Props` is cooked, so a text file
   in it needs its own stage line). props1 owns that.

## 2. Use the real catalogue

```
cp ../../Content/Props/catalogue.txt data/catalogue.txt
python -c "from sc_build import load_data; d = load_data(); print(len(d['catalogue']), 'props, hash', d['catalogue_hash'])"
```

The second line must print the prop count and a hash. It stops with an error if a line lacks one of the seven keys
(`name mesh category class blocks open size`). gen1's reader wants `open` on every line, `blocks=0` lines too. If the
real file leaves it off those lines, that is a one-line change in `load_catalogue` in `sc_build.py`: write it down
in this file when you make it.

Made by lane rebake1, 14 Nov 2026, for props1's catalogue (125 props, hash `cb703ef0`). Three changes in
`load_catalogue`, each one line:

- `blocks=0` lines have no `open`: it is read as `open=0` there. Only `blocks=1` props use `open`.
- Three flat hall floor pieces have `size=400,400,0`. The reader now takes the game's rule (`SupercutProps.cpp`):
  0 is allowed on a prop that does not block, never on one that blocks.

import argparse

    """A winding stage (lane gen3) is not one room the grid checker can read: the generator checks each chamber alone
       and the stage rules (sc_wind.wound_rules). So: build the stage again from its header and compare the bytes, and
       the rebuilt stage must have kept every rule."""
    head = dict(w.split("=") for w in text.split("\n")[0].split() if "=" in w)
    props = 1 if "\n# catalogue=" in text else 0
    room = build_room(data, int(head["seed"]), int(head["depth"]), int(head["attempt"]), int(head["known"]), props)

# SUPERCUT room generator: winding stages (lane gen3, 15 Nov 2026).
# From plan.wind.from_depth on, a stage is a chain of chambers joined by doorways. Each chamber is built as a straight
# room of its own (cap_start, its modules, cap_gate) and passed by the fairness checker on its own, in its own axes.
# Then the chambers are turned by quarter turns and set down one after the other: a doorway in a side wall of one
# (a turn) or in its end wall (straight on) opens into a doorway in the next one's start wall. Only the first start
# and the last gate stay. Whole numbers only; every loop runs over a list.
#
# Why a stage never mixes a puzzle chamber with a fight: a puzzle chamber needs its refill pad to stay fair (a player
# may come in with no charge), and the game refuses a pad in a room with enemies (SupercutPuzzles.cpp, "a room has
# one or the other"). So a puzzle stage winds through puzzle chambers and a fight stage through fight chambers.

from sc_rng import Rng
from sc_plan import enemy_mix, by_depth
from sc_build import (SALT_ROOM, build_module, carve_pits, outer_walls, mirror_piece, dress, dress_box, piece_text,
                      FMT, normalise)

SALT_WIND = 4
VERSION = "gen3 wound v1"
SHOOTERS = ["grunt", "marksman"]


def chamber_count(P, depth):
    return by_depth(P["wind"]["chambers"], depth)["n"]


def choose_chambers(data, rng, slot):
    """A list of chambers; each is {'kind', 'mods': [[name, form, enemies, filmcan], ...], 'mk'}."""
    P = data["plan"]
    W = P["wind"]
    depth = slot["depth"]
    n = chamber_count(P, depth)
    learned = list(slot["learned"])
    form = by_depth(P["level_by_depth"], depth)["form"]
    out = []
    if slot["lesson"] != "":
        out.append({"kind": slot["kind"], "mods": [[P["lessons"][slot["lesson"]]["module"], "lesson", [], 0]], "mk": 0})
        learned.append(slot["lesson"])     # taught in the first chamber, practised in the rest
    if slot["kind"] == "puzzle":
        tags = [t for t in P["tags"] if t in learned and t in P["practice_modules"]]
        last = out[-1]["mods"][0][0] if len(out) > 0 else ""
        while len(out) < n:
            name = rng.pick(P["practice_modules"][rng.pick(tags)])
            if name == last:
                name = rng.pick(P["practice_modules"][rng.pick(tags)])
            out.append({"kind": "puzzle", "mods": [[name, form, [], 0]], "mk": 0})
            last = name
        return out

        """lo, lo+step, ... up to hi (hi is reached only if it is on a step)."""
        assert hi >= lo and step >= 1
        return lo + step * self.below((hi - lo) // step + 1)

    def pick(self, items):
        return items[self.below(len(items))]

    def chance(self, num, den):
        """True num times out of den."""
        return self.below(den) < num

    def shuffle(self, items):
        """Fisher-Yates, from the last index down. Shuffles the list in place."""

import math, os, re, sys

root = sys.argv[1]
num = r'(-?[\d.]+)'
vec = num + ',' + num + ',' + num
rows = []
for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(root):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.txt'):
            continue
        p = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
        gate = None
        boxes = []
        for line in open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'):
            line = line.split('#')[0].strip()
            m = re.match(r'gate\s+at=' + vec + r'\s+facing=' + num, line)
            if m:
                gate = [float(m.group(i)) for i in range(1, 5)]
            m = re.match(r'box\s+.*from=' + vec + r'\s+to=' + vec, line)
            if m:
                a = [float(m.group(i)) for i in range(1, 7)]
                boxes.append((min(a[0], a[3]), min(a[1], a[4]), min(a[2], a[5]), max(a[0], a[3]), max(a[1], a[4]), max(a[2], a[5])))
        if not gate:
            continue
        gx, gy, gz, face = gate
        rel = os.path.relpath(p, root).replace('\\', '/')
        if abs(face / 90 - round(face / 90)) > 0.001:
            rows.append((rel, 'not square', None, 0))
            continue
        c, s = round(math.cos(math.radians(-face))), round(math.sin(math.radians(-face)))
        def to_door(x, y):
            x, y = x - gx, y - gy
            return x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c
        best = None
        for b in boxes:
            pts = [to_door(x, y) for x in (b[0], b[3]) for y in (b[1], b[4])]
            xs = [q[0] for q in pts]; ys = [q[1] for q in pts]
            z0, z1 = b[2] - gz, b[5] - gz
            if min(ys) <= -55 and max(ys) >= 55 and z0 <= 0 and z1 >= 216 and -10.8 <= min(xs) <= 400:
                best = min(xs) if best is None else min(best, min(xs))
        if best is None:
            rows.append((rel, 'free', None, 0))
            continue
        shift = best + 2 - 1
        # the opening in door axes x [best, 142+shift-...]: from wall face to white back 142 (after shift)
        ox0, ox1 = best, shift + 142

UMaterialInterface* ASupercutRoom::RoleMaterial(const FString& RoleName)
{
	if (const TObjectPtr<UMaterialInterface>* Made = RoleMaterials.Find(RoleName))
	{
		return *Made;
	}
	const FSurfaceRole* Found = FindRole(RoleName);
	checkf(Found, TEXT("Room %s: \"%s\" is not a colour role. A piece type must check the word with ASupercutRoom::IsRole when it reads its line."), *RoomName, *RoleName);
	UMaterialInterface* Material = Found->Maquette ? SupercutShapes::Maquette(Found->Maquette)
		: Found->bGlows ? SupercutShapes::Glow(this, SupercutShapes::SignalColor(Found->Signal), SignalGlow(Found->Signal))
		: SupercutShapes::Solid(this, Found->Color, Found->Rough, Found->Strength > 0.f ? Found->Color * Found->Strength : FLinearColor::Black);
	if (RoleName == TEXT("floor"))
	{
		// The cutting mat takes a shade of its own, so the lamp can stay right for the foam walls.
		UMaterialInstanceDynamic* Mat = UMaterialInstanceDynamic::Create(Material, this);
		const float Shade = FSupercutTuning::Get().MatShade;
		Mat->SetVectorParameterValue(TEXT("Tint"), FLinearColor(Shade, Shade, Shade));
		Material = Mat;
	}
	RoleMaterials.Add(RoleName, Material);
	return Material;
}

UStaticMeshComponent* ASupercutRoom::AddShape(ESupercutShape Shape, const FVector& Location, const FRotator& Rotation, const FVector& SizeCm, UMaterialInterface* Material, bool bSolid)
{
	return SupercutShapes::Add(this, RootComponent, Shape, Location, Rotation, SizeCm, Material, bSolid ? TEXT("BlockAll") : TEXT("NoCollision"), EComponentMobility::Static);
}

UStaticMeshComponent* ASupercutRoom::AddBox(const FVector& Min, const FVector& Max, UMaterialInterface* Material, bool bSolid)
{
	UStaticMeshComponent* Part = AddShape(ESupercutShape::Cube, (Min + Max) * 0.5, FRotator::ZeroRotator, Max - Min, Material, bSolid);
	if (bSolid)
	{
		SolidBoxes.Add({ FBox(Min, Max), Part });
	}
	return Part;
}

Cause: since the loop lane's Stage B only scenes 1, 4, 7, ... (`USupercutRun::IsPickScene`, `PickEveryScenes` 3) end on an upgrade screen. After the other scenes the run enters the next room the moment the player crosses the exit (now 60 cm inside the frame, so the walk is longer). The script's old end-of-scene lines (`T move 0 0`, `T shot sN_upgrade_screen`, `T key One`) then run inside the NEXT room: the player kept walking about 190 cm off the start mark of scene 4 and its first scripted shot missed.

My fix for main8 is script-only (tool: `unreal/megajam-2026/tools_main/main8_nocards.py`, read it): for a scene that ends with no upgrade screen, drop those three lines so the script reaches the next `scene` line while still walking and waits there, and put `0 move 0 0` straight after that scene's `0 charges full`, so the walk stops on the first tick in the new room. I am proving it now with two runs.
