def read_tuning(names, file=None):
    """The game's own numbers from Source/Supercut/SupercutTuning.h, then any "Name = value" lines of a Tuning.txt
       the game is run with (it reads the same file beside Supercut.exe), so a change to the gun or the freeze needs
       only a re-bake. Fails if a name is missing."""
    import re
    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "..", "Source", "Supercut", "SupercutTuning.h")
    text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    out = {}
    for n in names:
        m = re.search(r"(?:^|\s)(?:float|int32)\s+%s\s*=\s*(-?[0-9.]+)f?\s*;" % n, text, re.M)
        if not m:
            raise SystemExit("bake_play: %s not found in %s" % (n, path))
        out[n] = float(m.group(1))
    if file:
        for line in open(file, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
            line = line.split("#")[0].strip()
    return chambers, enemies

{
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();

	RoomIndex = Tuning.LapEntryRoom - 1;
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("LAP %d: run %s from its room %d"), Lap, *LapRunName, Tuning.LapEntryRoom);
	ApplyLap();
}

last[0] + end + 40) / T[\"WalkSpeed\"] + 0.3, 2))\n    if is_pick_scene(scene):\n        plan.now(\"move 0 0\", 0.25)\n\n\ndef cards_after(plan, scene):\n    if is_pick_scene(scene):\n        plan.wait(0.6)\n        plan.now(\"key One\", 0.05)\n\n\nclass Baker:\n    def __init__(self, data, plan, cards=True):''')\n\nrep('''def bake_stage(data, plan, text, scene, shots=False, walk=False, last=False):\n    chambers, enemies = stage_chambers(data, text)\n    b = Baker(data, plan, cards=last or is_pick_scene(scene))''', '''def bake_stage(data, plan, text, scene, shots=False, walk=False):\n    chambers, enemies = stage_chambers(data, text)\n    b = Baker(data, plan, cards=is_pick_scene(scene))''')\n\nrep('''        try:\n            bake_stage(data, plan, text, k + 1, a.shots == k + 1, a.walk, k + 1 == len(names[:a.stages]))\n        except BakeError as e:\n            print(\"BAKE FAILED gen_s%d stage %d: %s\" % (a.seed, k + 1, e))\n            sys.exit(1)\n        if k + 1 < len(names[:a.stages]) and is_pick_scene(k + 1):\n            plan.wait(0.6)\n            plan.now(\"key One\", 0.05)\n    plan.now(\"report\", 1.0)''', '''        try:\n            bake_stage(data, plan, text, scene, a.shots == k + 1, a.walk)\n            cards_after(plan, scene)\n            scene += 1\n            if is_rest_scene(scene):\n                bake_rest(plan, a.content, rest.next(), scene)\n                cards_after(plan, scene)\n                scene += 1\n        except BakeError as e:\n            print(\"BAKE FAILED gen_s%d stage %d: %s\" % (a.seed, k + 1, e))\n            sys.exit(1)\n    # The run goes on past the last baked room (into the next room, a rest room or a lap: lane loop1), so the script\n    # ends in that scene, with no line between the walk into the last exit and its scene line.\n    plan.scene(scene, stop=not is_pick_scene(scene - 1))\n    plan.comment(\"scene %d: past the last baked room; the script ends here\" % scene)\n    plan.now(\"report\", 1.0)''')\n\nrep('''    names = [n for n in names if n]\n    for k, name in enumerate(names[:a.stages]):''', '''    names = [n for n in names if n]\n    rest = RestPicker(a.play_seed, a.content)\n    scene = 1\n    for k, name in enumerate(names[:a.stages]):''')\n\nrep('''    ap.add_argument(\"--stages\", type=int, default=12)''', '''    ap.add_argument(\"--stages\", type=int, default=12)\n    ap.add_argument(\"--play-seed\", type=int, required=True,\n                    help=\"the -Seed the script is played with: it decides which rest room each rest scene draws\")''')\n\nout = t.replace(\"\\n\", \"\\r\\n\") if crlf else t\nopen(p, \"wb\").write(out.encode(\"utf-8\"))\nprint(\"ok crlf\", crlf)\n"

def door_shift(ch, g):
    """How far along its facing the game moves the exit door from the gate line g (own axes, facing +x): the nearest
       room box ahead that covers the doorway, its face + 1 cm; 0 when none is within reach (FitDoorToWall)."""
    near = None
    for p in ch.pieces:
        if p["t"] != "box":
            continue
        x0, y0, z0 = p["from"][0] - g[0], p["from"][1] - g[1], p["from"][2] - g[2]
        x1, y1, z1 = p["to"][0] - g[0], p["to"][1] - g[1], p["to"][2] - g[2]
        if y0 <= -DOOR_HALF and y1 >= DOOR_HALF and z0 <= 0 and z1 >= DOOR_TALL and DOOR_FLAT_FRONT <= x0 <= DOOR_WALL_REACH:
            near = x0 if near is None else min(near, x0)
    return 0 if near is None else near + 1

def parse_room(text):
    """Returns {'pieces': [...], 'errors': [...], 'head': {...}}. Each piece carries 'line' (its line number)."""
    pieces = []
    errors = []
    head = {}
    number = 0
    for raw in text.split("\n"):
        number += 1
        line = raw.strip()
        if line == "":
            continue
        if line[0] == "#":
            for word in line[1:].split():
                if "=" in word:
                    k, v = word.split("=", 1)
                    if k not in head:
                        head[k] = v
            if line.startswith("# modules:"):
                head["modules"] = line[len("# modules:"):].strip()
            continue
        words = line.split()
        t = words[0]
        if t not in FMT:
            errors.append("line %d: no piece type '%s'" % (number, t))
            continue
        given = {}
        bad = 0
        for w in words[1:]:

                continue

1	# props4: collision of the film can's stand and the refill board (16 Nov 2026, 00:15)
2	
3	Room-file coordinates, cm. `start` is the room's `start at=` point, `at` the piece's `at=` point. Both pieces turn the
4	same way: let `u = unit(at.xy - start.xy)` along the floor (u = (1, 0) when at.xy equals start.xy), and
5	`yaw = atan2(u.y, u.x)` in degrees. Each box is a box turned by `yaw` about Z: its own X runs along u, its own Y along
6	(-u.y, u.x). Nothing else of either prop collides.
7	
8	| Piece | Box size X x Y x Z | Box centre | Notes |
9	| --- | --- | --- | --- |
10	| `filmcan at=` (the stand) | 56.6 x 65.1 x 104.1 | `at + (0, 0, 52.05)` | the stand mesh's bounds; the clapperboard on its tray does not collide |
11	| `refill at=` (the board) | 74.0 x 142.0 x 160.0 | `at + 75 * u + (0, 0, 80)` | the board mesh's bounds; its pivot is 75 cm past the pad's centre, away from the start; the six clapperboards do not collide |
12	
13	- Half extents: stand (28.3, 32.55, 52.05), board (37, 71, 80).
14	- What they stop: the player and shots (and anything else that traces WorldStatic/Visibility), like a solid catalogued
15	  prop (`BlockAll`). Enemies are let through them (`IgnoreComponentWhenMoving`, the way the room lets enemies through
16	  film gear) `[pick]`: a Rusher that lunges into a stand would stop dead on it, and enemy movement code is not touched.
17	- For a walk checker, grow each box by the player's capsule radius, 34 cm.
18	- The pickup still works on contact: the stand's half diagonal is 43.1 cm, so a player touching it from any side has
19	  their middle at most 43.1 + 34 = 77.1 cm from `at`, inside `FilmCanReach` 80. The board's front face is 38 cm past
20	  the pad's centre, so the player (radius 34) can stand on the pad's centre, inside `RefillReach` 90.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- a chamber in its own axes

class Chamber:
    def __init__(self, data, info, index, last):
        self.i = index
        self.last = last
        self.O = info["O"]
        self.d = info["d"]
        self.zo = info["zo"]
        self.hw = info["hw"]
        self.L = info["length"]
        self.ys = info["ys"]
        self.yg = info["yg"]
        self.z_exit = info["z_exit"]
        self.segs = info["segs"]
        self.kind = info["kind"]
        self.exit = info["exit"]
        self.pieces = [p for p in info["pieces"] if p["t"] not in ("fall", "keylight")]
        cat = {q["name"]: q for q in data["catalogue"]}
        self.solids = [p["from"] + p["to"] for p in self.pieces if p["t"] == "box"]
        self.sight = list(self.solids)
        for p in info["dress"]:
            q = cat[p["name"]]
            if q["blocks"] == 1:
                b = dress_box(p["at"], q["size"], p["turn"], q["from"])
                self.solids.append(b)
                if q["open"] == 0:
                    self.sight.append(b)
        # A shot leaves the gun, not the eye, and spreads: a place counts as seeing an enemy only past a margin
        # (and the gun sits below the eye, so a shot down past an edge clips it: tops count 40 cm higher)
        self.sight_fat = [[b[0] - SHOT_MARGIN, b[1] - SHOT_MARGIN, b[2], b[3] + SHOT_MARGIN, b[4] + SHOT_MARGIN, b[5] + 40]
                          for b in self.sight]
        self.lava = [p["from"] + p["to"] for p in self.pieces if p["t"] == "kill"]
        self.x0 = -150
        self.y0 = -self.hw - 60
        self.nx = (self.L + 300) // CELL + 1
        self.ny = (2 * self.hw + 120) // CELL + 1
        self.grids = {}

    def world(self, v, z=None):
        w = turn_xy([v[0], v[1]], self.d)
        out = [self.O[0] + w[0], self.O[1] + w[1]]
        if z is not None:
            out.append(self.zo + z)
        return out

    def local(self, w):
        dx, dy = w[0] - self.O[0], w[1] - self.O[1]
        # inverse of turn_xy: own x along d, own y along d turned left
        return [dx * self.d[0] + dy * self.d[1], -dx * self.d[1] + dy * self.d[0]]

    def of(self, t, x0=None, x1=None):
        out = []
        for p in self.pieces:
            if p["t"] != t:
                continue
            at = p["at"] if "at" in p else p["from"]
            if x0 is not None and not (x0 <= at[0] <= x1):
                continue
            out.append(p)
        return out

729:def stage_chambers(data, text):
def stage_chambers(data, text):
    head = dict(w.split("=") for w in text.split("\n")[0].split() if "=" in w)
    props = 1 if "\n# catalogue=" in text else 0
    room = build_room(data, int(head["seed"]), int(head["depth"]), int(head["attempt"]), int(head["known"]), props)
    if room["text"] != text:
        raise BakeError("the stage file is not what the generator builds from its header")
    m = room["meta"]
    pieces = parse_room(text)["pieces"]
    if m.get("wound"):
        infos = m["laid"]
    else:
        st = [p for p in pieces if p["t"] == "start"][0]
        gt = [p for p in pieces if p["t"] == "gate"][0]
        infos = [{"O": [0, 0], "d": [1, 0], "zo": 0, "hw": m["hw"], "length": m["length"], "ys": st["at"][1],
                  "yg": gt["at"][1], "z_exit": 0, "segs": m["segs"], "kind": m["kind"], "exit": None,
                  "pieces": [p for p in pieces if p["t"] != "dress"], "dress": [p for p in pieces if p["t"] == "dress"]}]
    chambers = [Chamber(data, infos[i], i, i == len(infos) - 1) for i in range(len(infos))]
    enemies = []
    for p in pieces:
        if p["t"] in ENEMIES:
            roam = []
            if "home_from" in p:
                # the home area's corners, 40 cm in, and its middle, at the enemy's height
                a, b, z = p["home_from"], p["home_to"], p["at"][2]
                xs = [min(a[0] + 40, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2), max(b[0] - 40, (a[0] + b[0]) / 2)]
                ys = [min(a[1] + 40, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2), max(b[1] - 40, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2)]
                roam = [[x, y, z] for x in xs for y in ys] + [[(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, z]]
            enemies.append([len(enemies), p["t"], p["at"], roam])
    return chambers, enemies

class Baker:
    def __init__(self, data, plan, cards=True):
        self.data = data
        self.plan = plan
        self.cards = cards                 # the stage ends on an upgrade screen (or ends the script): stop at its exit
        self.zf = 0
        self.charges = int(T["Charges"])   # the board as the game keeps it (USupercutTime), without upgrades
        self.reserve = 0                   # charges the rest of this chamber's machines need

    def clap(self, dt):
        """A machine's clap: it must have a charge, or the stage cannot be played as planned."""
        if self.charges <= 0:
            raise BakeError("a machine needs a clap and the board is empty")
        self.charges -= 1
        self.plan.now("clap", dt)

    def goto(self, ch, v, near=40, secs=20, z=None):
        w = ch.world(v)
        self.plan.at_t("goto %d %d %d %d" % (w[0], w[1], near, secs))
        self.pos = [v[0], v[1]]

    def walk(self, ch, v, zf=None, near=40):
        zf = self.zf if zf is None else zf
        pts = ch.route(self.pos, v, zf)
        for k, p in enumerate(pts):
            self.goto(ch, p, near if k == len(pts) - 1 else 60)
        self.pos = [v[0], v[1]]

    def stop(self):
        self.plan.now("move 0 0", 0.25)

    def lane(self, ch, y):
        return max(-ch.hw + 150, min(ch.hw - 150, y))

def door_shift(ch, g):
    """How far along its facing the game moves the exit door from the gate line g (own axes, facing +x): the nearest
       room box ahead that covers the doorway, its face + 1 cm; 0 when none is within reach (FitDoorToWall)."""
    near = None
    for p in ch.pieces:
        if p["t"] != "box":

        x0, y0, z0 = p["from"][0] - g[0], p["from"][1] - g[1], p["from"][2] - g[2]

                      % (self.head["catalogue"], data["catalogue_hash"]))
        for p in self.room["pieces"]:
            if p["t"] != "dress":
                self.pieces.append(p)
                continue
            q = None
            for c in data["catalogue"]:
                if c["name"] == p["name"]:
                    q = c

                self.fail("prop", "line %d: no prop '%s' in the catalogue" % (p["line"], p["name"]))
                continue
            if banned_prop(D, p["name"]):

                continue
            box = dress_box(p["at"], q["size"], p["turn"], q["from"])
            if q["blocks"] == 1 and q["open"] == 1:
                self.pieces.append({"t": "box", "role": "crate", "from": box[0:3], "to": box[3:6], "line": p["line"], "open": 1})
            elif q["blocks"] == 1:
                self.pieces.append({"t": "box", "role": "crate", "from": box[0:3], "to": box[3:6], "line": p["line"]})
            else:
                self.pieces.append({"t": "prop", "name": p["name"], "at": p["at"], "box": box, "line": p["line"]})

    def fail(self, code, what):
        self.fails.append(code + ": " + what)

    def of(self, t):
        return [p for p in self.pieces if p["t"] == t]
